description: This file defines the Content class responsible for generating the main content XML for ODS spreadsheets in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It handles writing styles, sheets, rows, and cells, including formulas, comments, and merged cells.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Handles writing the content.xml for an ODS spreadsheet, including sheets, rows, cells, styles, formulas, comments, and merged cells.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Content writer with an Ods parent writer and sets up formula convertor.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Generates the XML content for content.xml, including document setup, styles, sheets, and additional features.

methods.name: writeSheets
methods.description: Iterates over each sheet in the spreadsheet and writes its content.

methods.name: writeRows
methods.description: Writes all rows of a sheet, managing row repetition for empty rows.

methods.name: writeCells
methods.description: Writes all cells in a row, including handling of cell types, formulas, comments, and merged cells.

methods.name: writeCellSpan
methods.description: Handles the spanning of cells for merged or repeated cells.

methods.name: writeXfStyles
methods.description: Writes style information for columns and rows to the style XML.

methods.name: writeCellMerge
methods.description: Writes the attributes for a merged cell range if the cell is part of a merged range.
